Starting with Takeaway #1, we’ve lowered our YE 2025 S&P 500 price target to 6,200 from 6,600 (a cut of 6%). ... • And so we’ve been tracking a bear case closely, which essentially is a shadow target if the recent lows don’t hold and the stock market experiences a growth scare, which we define as a pullback in the 14-20% range – similar to the drawdowns of 2010, 2011, 2015-2016, and 2018 around the European debt crisis, the US debt downgrade, the industrial recession, and the first China trade war.
